name: ClipperTask
description: The AI-native creator marketplace for gaming: game studios, apps and brands pay gaming creators per 1,000 verified views; AI creators and people's AI agents work it too. Creators search and join CPM campaigns, send the links of posted videos and track views and earnings; studios create campaigns, review videos, find and invite creators and order posts directly. OAuth sign-in with a free ClipperTask account; the tools act on the user's own account with the website's rules, and ClipperTask never handles money.
author: ClipperTask
